tagline: Select it. Describe it. Reimagine it.

hero.title: Your Video. Your Vision. Reimagined by AI.
hero.subtitle: Select any object in your video and transform it with the power of generative AI.

features.title: Everything you need to reimagine video

select.title: Click to select
select.body: Pause on any frame and click an object. SAM 3.1 segments and tracks it across the video.

remove.title: Remove anything
remove.body: Video inpainting reconstructs the background with temporal consistency — no flicker.

replace.title: Replace with AI
replace.body: Describe the replacement in words. Muse Image generates it; ReFrameAI composites it into every frame.

agent.title: AI assistant
agent.body: Muse Spark turns plain-language instructions into structured editing plans.

how.title: How it works
how.s1b: Drop in an MP4, MOV or WebM video.
how.s2b: Click the object you want to change.
how.s3b: Tell the AI what to remove, replace or restyle.
how.s4b: Preview side-by-side and export an MP4.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.note: Indicative pricing — configure plans before launch.
